facts.fact: La Nation reports the three operators signed on 4 February 2026 in Djibouti the agreement launching Horizon, a terrestrial fibre corridor of nearly 2,800 km with 144 fibre pairs linking Djibouti, Addis Ababa and Port Sudan, to be built.
La Nation states the contract follows a memorandum of understanding signed in Addis Ababa on 4 December 2024 by the three operators.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
